adulteration_type.override_note: The raw macro-F1 search winner was NOT shipped -- its edge was concentrated in noise-fitting on the statistically unlearnable 'Excess Salt' class (Cohen's d <= 0.11 on every feature) at a real cost to None recall/accuracy. The shipped model is a RandomForest(n_estimators=400, max_depth=16, min_samples_leaf=1, min_samples_split=4, max_features=0.5) that matches the search winner on every genuinely-detectable class and dominates the original train.py baseline on accuracy, macro-F1, and balanced accuracy simultaneously. See reports/refinement_report.txt for the full comparison.
